findings.title: Unguarded access to integration.metadata['sender']['login'] can raise KeyError
findings.body: `integration.metadata["sender"]["login"]` is indexed directly. The `sender` key is only populated in `build_integration` when `state.get("sender")` is truthy (i.e. set by the installation webhook); for integrations created before this change, or when the webhook has not been received/processed yet, the key is absent and this raises KeyError, producing a 500 instead of the intended error page. Use `.get("sender", {}).get("login")` and treat a missing value as a verification failure.

findings.title: safe_urlopen call for token exchange is not error-handled
findings.body: `safe_urlopen(url=ghip.get_oauth_access_token_url(), data=data)` is outside the try/except that only wraps `safe_urlread`/parsing. A network failure, timeout, or non-2xx handling inside safe_urlopen raises, so a transient GitHub outage during installation yields an unhandled 500 rather than the intended user-facing "invalid installation request" page. Wrap the request in the same try/except.

findings.title: get_user_info result assumed to be a dict
findings.body: `get_user_info(payload["access_token"])` result is immediately checked with `"login" not in authenticated_user_info`. If the call raises (ApiError on 401/5xx from GitHub) or returns None, this either propagates an exception or raises TypeError, resulting in a 500 during installation instead of the graceful error page. Guard the call with try/except and a None check.

findings.title: State comparison is not constant-time
findings.body: `request.GET.get("state") != pipeline.signature` compares a user-supplied value against the pipeline signature (a secret-derived HMAC) with a non-constant-time `!=`. Since this value is now the sole CSRF/authenticity guard for the OAuth callback, prefer `hmac.compare_digest` to avoid timing-based signature discovery.

findings.title: test_installation_not_found no longer tests the 404 installation path
findings.body: The test passes `state=ddd023d87a913d5226e2a882c4c4cc05`, which does not match the pipeline signature used elsewhere (`9cae5e88803f35ed7970fc131e6e65d3`), so the request now fails at the new state-mismatch check in `OAuthLoginView` and the assertion `b"Invalid installation request."` passes without ever reaching `get_installation_info`. The previously covered behaviour ("The GitHub installation could not be found." when GitHub returns 404 for the installation) is now untested; the 404 branch in `build_integration` has no coverage.
